empirical_firewall: no empirical directional, occurrence or genetic outcome accessed
failure_policy: retain fail; do not tune candidate operators, seeds, thresholds or statuses after inspection

gates.all_rules_occurrence_compatible: coverage == 1.0 for all rules and seeds
gates.combined_statuses_separate_rules: true compatible, permissive indistinguishable, reverse-dominant contradicted for all seeds
gates.permissive_direction_ambiguous: all directional constraints ambiguous for all seeds
gates.reverse_direction_contradicted: all directional constraints contradicted for all seeds
gates.true_direction_supported: all directional constraints supported for all seeds

selection_policy: no winner score or posterior; evidence-specific qualitative statuses remain separate
